flowchart LR
    M["Kestrel and Pine, the controller"] -->|"instructions and DPA"| P["Processors: platform, WMS, ERP, iPaaS, returns portal, apps"]

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as The customer
    participant O as Request orchestrator
    participant I as Identity index
    participant P as The platform and its apps
    participant E as ERP, WMS, POS, warehouse
    participant X as Carriers, marketplace, PSP
    C->>O: deletion request, verified
    O->>I: which systems hold this person
    I-->>O: nine systems and their ids
    O->>P: delete account, redact orders, notify apps
    O->>E: erase, pseudonymize or retain per table
    O->>X: notify and refer the customer
    P-->>O: done, app answers within 30 days
    E-->>O: done, invoices retained
    O->>C: reply with what was done and where to ask next

flowchart TB
    PR["The person: profile, addresses, e-mail, consent, behavior"] -->|"erase on request or at end of own retention"| GONE["Erased"]
    TX["The transaction: order, invoice, credit note, shipment"] -->|"keep for the fiscal period"| KEEP["Retained with a pseudonymous customer reference"]
    PR -.->|"customer reference, one way"| TX
